1. Engagement Scope

This report outlines findings from a compliance review of Greenbrook Consulting's leave of absence administration processes. The scope covered FMLA, ADA, and state-specific leave laws in 19 states, and included a review of 120 leave cases from the period 1985-01-01 to 1986-03-28.

2. Methodology

The methodology for this review was aligned with the PCAOB auditing standards for an audit of internal control over financial reporting. Testing included design effectiveness assessments and operating effectiveness testing for {n} key controls.

4. Detailed Findings
EER-2487-001MEDIUMMONITORING
Observation

Emergency Action Plan not reviewed or updated in the last 12 months for the 19 facility

Corrective Action Required

Establish a formal process for reviewing and responding to all accommodation requests under the ADA and PWFA, including standardized forms for documenting the interactive process.

Management Response

The condition identified has been partially remediated. Greenbrook Consulting has addressed the majority of the affected population and is on track for full closure by the due date. A status update will be provided at the next scheduled review.

Owner: Chief Customer Officer • Due: 1985-03-28
EER-8219-002INFORMATIONALMONITORING
Observation

Compensation equity variance exceeds 15% threshold across protected class segments

Corrective Action Required

Implement a centralized job classification review process with documented approval workflow. All reclassification decisions must be signed off by the designated owner and retained for a minimum of 3 years per applicable recordkeeping requirements.

Management Response

The finding is acknowledged. This issue was caused by a temporary system outage on 1985-01-01. The system has been restored, and the backlog of affected transactions has been cleared. We consider this matter closed.

Owner: Vice President of Technology • Due: 1985-02-28
EER-8325-003INFORMATIONALDEFERRED
Observation

Variable pay accrual methodology inconsistent with Dodd-Frank Act Section 952 (Compensation Committee Independence); SEC Rule 14a-8 (shareholder proposals) disclosure requirements

Corrective Action Required

All managers and HR personnel involved in the hiring process must complete training on compliant interviewing techniques, including prohibitions on questions related to age, disability, national origin, and other protected characteristics.

Management Response

This finding has been superseded by a subsequent internal audit finding which addresses the same root cause with a more comprehensive corrective action plan. We request this finding be closed and tracked under the new internal audit reference number.

Owner: Vice President of Government Affairs • Due: 1985-05-28
EER-8984-004LOWIN PROGRESS
Observation

System access for 120 terminated employees not revoked within the 24-hour SLA defined by IT security policy

Corrective Action Required

All managers and HR personnel involved in the hiring process must complete training on compliant interviewing techniques, including prohibitions on questions related to age, disability, national origin, and other protected characteristics.

Management Response

We are awaiting final evidence of remediation from the third-party vendor responsible for this process. We have received their commitment to provide the necessary documentation by 1985-01-01 and will forward it to ACPWB upon receipt.

Owner: Chief Financial Officer • Due: 1985-03-28
EER-5574-005LOWIN PROGRESS
Observation

Equity grant documentation incomplete for awards issued during the review period

Corrective Action Required

The Compensation Committee shall convene a special meeting to review the identified financial restatement and initiate clawback procedures for all applicable executive incentive compensation.

Management Response

We concur. A project charter has been approved to address this finding. The project manager has been assigned, and a kickoff meeting is scheduled for 1985-01-01.

Owner: Technology Project Manager • Due: 1985-04-28
EER-5099-006INFORMATIONALDEFERRED
Observation

Employee handbook contains policies that could be construed as chilling NLRA-protected concerted activity

Corrective Action Required

All managers will be required to complete a biennial training course on disability awareness and the ADA interactive process, with completion rates reported to the Chief Diversity Officer.

Management Response

Corrective action is complete. The revised policy was approved by the Board on 1985-01-01 and has been communicated to all employees. A copy of the communication and the approved policy is attached as evidence.

Owner: Director of Grants Management • Due: 1985-05-28
